title: Lively Craft
description: Lively Craft is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly modpack that improves Minecraft with better performance, cleaner visuals, quality-of-life tweaks, and a more alive world.
body:
## 📦 Lively Craft

**Lively Craft** is a **lightweight**, **performance-friendly** Minecraft modpack made to refresh the vanilla experience without changing how the game feels.

It focuses on **better FPS**, **cleaner visuals**, **quality-of-life improvements**, and a more **alive world**, while still keeping the classic Minecraft style.

## ✨ Main Features

* **Better Performance**
  Includes performance mods that help improve **FPS**, reduce **stutters**, speed up **chunk loading**, and make the game feel better overall.

* **Vanilla-Friendly Visual Upgrades**
  Adds cleaner textures, improved lighting, better particles, connected glass, improved animations, better foliage, enhanced mobs, and optional shader support.

* **More Alive World**
  The world feels more detailed with improved structures, better biomes, enhanced Nether and End generation, ambient effects, and small visual details that make exploration more interesting.

* **Quality-of-Life Improvements**
  Adds useful features like better tooltips, improved UI, inventory tweaks, better shulker boxes, enchantment info, zoom, and other small comfort changes.

* **Resource Packs & Shaders**
  Includes resource packs and shaders that make Minecraft look better while still feeling close to vanilla.

## 🎮 What Makes It Special?

Lively Craft doesn’t try to turn Minecraft into a completely different game. Instead, it improves the original experience by making it look better, feel better, and be more comfortable to play.

It is made for players who want Minecraft to feel more **fresh**, **alive**, and **vibrant** without using heavy or game-changing mods.
